record.paper: The Last Temptation of William T. Tutte

dossier_meta.paper: The Last Temptation of William T. Tutte
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every planar triangulation whose 4-coloring complex is disconnected, there is a component of even parity and a component of odd parity.
dossier_meta.context_text: After resolving Tutte's original question by constructing triangulations with arbitrarily many same-parity components, the authors identify this closely related conjecture based on extensive computation. It refines the picture by asserting that disconnected coloring complexes always contain both parities.
